selected.alt: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women seated closely on blue cushions beside a waterfront at dusk, with the Kuwait Towers in the background. A braided woman in a pearl-white outfit with turquoise circular panels rests her head near a blonde woman's shoulder. Two women wear green, white, red and black cropped outfits; the fourth wears a copper beaded mini. Small star tattoos and RAZE marks appear, with white boots, blue pumps and rainbow platform heels partly visible.

Rose, GRD and scorpion tattoos, rainbow pumps and platforms, and bronze knee-high boots add variety.

AI-generated fictional fashion scene of four adult women on cushioned seating beside a coast. A blonde woman gently hugs a seated braided woman from behind while another woman leans forward to clasp her hand, and the fourth leans in at right. Their outfits include green-white-red-black minis, a white cropped top with a navy skirt, and a black-and-copper cropped mini outfit. Blue platforms, coral sandals, white knee-high boots, rainbow boots and arm tattoos vary across the group. Distant smoke and a mushroom-shaped cloud are imaginary scenery, not a real disaster.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women beside reeds and shallow-water reflections under a wooden shade shelter. A braided woman and a blonde woman share a side hug while a seated woman touches their forearms and another leans toward her temple. They wear opaque emerald, ivory-and-navy, and green-white-red-black color-blocked mini outfits with covered midriffs. Pearl-trimmed reed patterns, agency and silent king arm tattoos, navy boots and rainbow knee-high boots appear in the diagonally framed scene.
